dashboard:herdr-core.summary: Follow factory status, resources, estimated cost and alerts in the Herdr app.
dashboard:herdr-core.use_when: Watch active goals, machine capacity and requests for attention from your Mac.

plugin:hivemill.summary: The guided installer for the legacy pipeline. The runner is built from source.
plugin:hivemill.use_when: Install the legacy pipeline on a Debian or Ubuntu host. For the runner, follow the installation guide.
plugin:hivemill.requirements: A fresh Debian or Ubuntu host and a logged-in Claude Code. The installer guide documents the remaining dependencies.

plugin:hivemill-spend.summary: Inspect Claude token usage and configure worker context limits.
plugin:hivemill-spend.use_when: Investigate costly sessions or reduce oversized worker contexts on a factory host.
plugin:hivemill-spend.requirements: Claude Code and access to the local Claude session data you want to inspect.

role:boss.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): was the owner’s chat contact that turned requests into goals. The runner’s planner and owner queue replace it.
role:boss.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:cleaner.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): kept workspaces tidy through scoped housekeeping tasks.
role:cleaner.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:coder.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): implemented a task and opened a pull request for separate review. The runner’s task session replaces it.
role:coder.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:director.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): staffed teams and assigned goals to leads. Projects and the planner replace it.
role:director.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:evaluator.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): ran an evaluation task inside a controlled sandbox.
role:evaluator.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:judge.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): merged on passing reviewer and QA verdicts. The runner’s task judge and mechanical merge replace it.
role:judge.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:lead.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): planned the tasks of one goal and coordinated its team. The planner replaces it.
role:lead.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:planner.summary: Keeps each project’s queue of ready tasks full, splits tasks that are too big and asks the owner when it needs a decision.
role:planner.use_when: Keep the runner busy with small tasks that pass the spec gate, without typing every task yourself.

role:pm.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): turned a request into requirements and acceptance criteria. The planner and the spec gate replace it.
role:pm.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:qa.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): tested a change against its acceptance criteria. The runner’s proof re-runs replace it.
role:qa.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:researcher.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): investigated one question and wrote a report. Research as a task kind is planned.
role:researcher.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:retro.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): reviewed rejected work and proposed process changes.
role:retro.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:reviewer.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): reviewed a pull request and recorded findings. /code-review in the task session and the judge replace it.
role:reviewer.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:scout.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): assessed candidate skills through read-only research.
role:scout.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:staff-engineer.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): gave technical advice on one engineering decision.
role:staff-engineer.use_when: Read it as a reference for the legacy pipeline, which is paused and kept as the rollback. New work runs on the Hivemill runner.

role:task.summary: One Claude Code session per task: implement, run the tests, run /code-review, fix the findings and open the pull request.
role:task.use_when: Run each task in one session whose work a Stop-hook gate checks by re-running every test and command proof.

role:task-judge.summary: A fresh, read-only judge that maps every behaviour change in the diff to a criterion and answers MERGE, REJECT or HOLD.
role:task-judge.use_when: Decide a merge independently of the session that wrote the change, and catch changes nobody asked for.

skill:hivemill-spend/agent-context-limit.summary: Limit worker context while preserving a larger context for the coordinating agent.
skill:hivemill-spend/agent-context-limit.use_when: Reduce unnecessary context growth across worker sessions on a factory host.
skill:hivemill-spend/agent-context-limit.requirements: Claude Code and the hivemill-spend plugin on the host where worker settings will be configured.

skill:hivemill-spend/token-spend-audit.summary: Find costly Claude sessions and practical ways to reduce token use.
skill:hivemill-spend/token-spend-audit.use_when: Understand which models, sessions and context patterns drive estimated Claude spend.
skill:hivemill-spend/token-spend-audit.requirements: Claude Code, the hivemill-spend plugin and readable local Claude session logs.

skill:hivemill/setup.summary: Guide Claude Code through installing the legacy pipeline.
skill:hivemill/setup.use_when: Set up the legacy pipeline with the installer. For the runner, follow the installation guide.
skill:hivemill/setup.requirements: A fresh Debian or Ubuntu host and a logged-in Claude Code. The installer guide documents the remaining dependencies.

skill:hivemill/web.summary: Legacy pipeline (paused): file a web delivery goal from one sentence.
skill:hivemill/web.use_when: Send a change through the legacy pipeline’s review, QA and merge decision.

skill:hm-clean.summary: Planned tools for deterministic factory resource cleanup.
skill:hm-clean.use_when: Inspect the resource-hygiene proposal and implementation status.
